summary: Kalra coauthored California SCR 105 calling for an end to the humanitarian crisis in Gaza and release of all hostages, and posted an X parallel between LA wildfire displacement and Palestinians. CAIR Action endorsed him and Vote for Peace rated him Ally. On AB 715, an antisemitism-coordinator bill, he abstained. His documented action and endorsements align with pro-Palestine positions, though his legislative language frames the situation as a humanitarian crisis rather than naming genocide or opposing US military aid.
